structure.purpose: Project manifest (project-manifest@1): name (= hub folder /projects/<name>), repo, relation to AXF, shared data. Nothing is loaded or compiled without a valid one.
App identity, framework version and the default asset for every slot.
Hashes of the baked framework files, used for conformance checks.
Baked framework runtime: engines, React layer and base CSS. Managed by the build engine.
App views registered with the shell (Studio = the IDE workspace).
Hot-swappable assets, one folder per asset type.

The studio: walkthrough-project@1 model, compiler (walkthrough-timeline@1), store + persistence (device / axHub data server), workspace (panes, layouts, dockable + floating toolbars), commands, drag-and-drop, panes, dialogs.
Registers every studio command as an AXF action.
App dialogs (the studio's plus the developer console).
Self-test of the model and the compiler (npx -y tsx test.mts).
